_readme: Single source of truth for all cases. Every value has a status: CONFIRMED (given by the user/TF), CHOSEN (our choice, reasoning in the note), SOURCED (from a cited reference, see materials/Ti6Al4V_sources.md) or DERIVED (computed from other entries). SI units throughout. Edit here, then re-run scripts/make_cases.py.

length_x.note: Dataset template: same 24 mm block as trial runs A-G so all rows are comparable and each 5 s run takes ~25 min (user budget 30 min). The full 50 mm block costs ~1.5x.

half_width_y.note: Modelled half width; symmetry plane y=0 on the track centreline, real block 20 mm wide.

depth_z.note: Top surface z=0, bottom z=-8 mm.

roi_y.note: Fine region 8 mm from the symmetry plane (user's 5 mm widened): at 1 mm/s and 2.5 kW the pool reaches ~17 mm full width (test G, 4 s).

roi_z.note: Fine-grid corner, 5 mm below the top surface.

outer_cell.note: Target cell size at the far boundaries outside the ROI (graded).

fine_x_start.note: Fine cells over nearly the whole 24 mm block, as in A-G.

cell_size.note: Fixed grid (user: no mesh study; 200 um chosen over 150 um for run time, ~3 h vs ~9 h for all three speeds). Pool ~3.4 mm deep spans ~17 cells.

absorptivity.note: Reference value (Much et al. 2024). Each run sets its own absorptivity; in this model only laser_power x absorptivity matters.

depth.note: Penetration depth of AdditiveFOAM's volumetric superGaussian; ~surface heating. Same in all meshes.

k.note: k=2 makes the superGaussian a plain Gaussian.

x_end.note: Reached at 3.2 s at 5 mm/s (then laser off until end_time); not reached by slower runs.

runs.note: Dataset runs (user: vary power, absorptivity, beam radius and speed on a fixed grid). speed m/s, laser_power W, radius m (1/e^2). No two rows share the same speed, absorbed power (laser_power x absorptivity) and radius. Trial runs A-G (docs/SIMULATION_PLAN.md section 7) are extra rows.

h_bottom.note: Workpiece-workbench h_d (Pariona Eq. 8) has no value given; Gao's 25 used; no radiation at the bottom.

A_mush.note: TF notes 'Aroush ~ 1e8': Carman-Kozeny constant C of Farzadi Eq. 2 (kg/m3/s).

B.note: TF notes. AdditiveFOAM caps solid fraction at 0.95 instead, so B is not used unless we modify UEqn.H.

DAS.note: AdditiveFOAM uses D = nu*180/DAS^2 * fs^2/(1-fs)^3, so DAS = sqrt(180*mu/A_mush).

maxCo.note: Tested stable in test G (max Co 0.90, no errors); ~1.8x fewer steps than 0.5.

write_interval.note: Field snapshots every 0.25 s; Tmax/Umax/pool dimensions logged every step.

end_time.note: Every run is 5 s of simulated time (~25 min on 8 cores at 200 um, user budget 30 min).
